name: Caching for Turborepo
description: Sets up Turborepo Remote Caching to work with GitHub Actions built-in cache. No Vercel account access tokens needed.

provider.description: Provider to use for caching (github, s3)

max-age.description: Cleanup cache files older than this age (ex: 1mo, 1w, 1d). using https://www.npmjs.com/package/parse-duration

max-files.description: Cleanup oldest cache files when number of files exceeds this limit (ex: 300)

max-size.description: Cleanup oldest cache files when total size exceeds this limit (ex: 100mb, 10gb)

s3-session-token.description: AWS S3 session token (optional, only required for temporary credentials e.g. OIDC authentication)

s3-endpoint.description: S3 endpoint (required when provider is s3)
